text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- The Cabinet to approve package of tax reforms with first impact to be felt in 1998.

- Fehst Componentes, a factory of the Grundig complex in Braga, northern Portugal, is hiring workers previously fired by Grundig Industry Portugal to produce the same telephones this company produced before. It has also applied for state support.
- The Minister of Social Solidarity says drive for companies and individual tax payers to pay off outstanding social security debts has been a success with some 58 percent paid so far.

- Francisco Murteira Nabo, chairman of Portugal Telecom, says he is contacting national investors that already own an important position in the company to increase it to reach 15 percent of the companies' capital to guarantee future stability.
- Lisgrafica, a graphic company, is studying seeking bourse listing, a process that may be completed within a year, managing director Alexandre Bras Monteiro said.
